content.value_statement: AI teams need consistent controls for model access, cost, safety, and observability. This skill guides Azure API Management setup for governed AI gateways.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to connect Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry backends to APIM.
Explains token rate limits, semantic caching, token metrics, and content safety policies.
Provides Azure CLI examples for gateway details, backend creation, role assignment, and testing.
Documents managed identity authentication patterns for production Azure workloads.
Includes troubleshooting guidance for authentication, rate limits, caching, content safety, and backend issues.
Links quick references for Azure API Management and Azure AI Content Safety SDKs.
limitations: It assumes an APIM instance and Azure AI resources already exist.
It does not deploy Azure infrastructure by itself.
Commands require Azure CLI access and permissions in the target subscription.
Policy examples may need changes for each tenant, region, model, and compliance requirement.

use_cases.title: Set Up Model Governance
use_cases.description: Configure APIM policies for token limits, caching, metrics, and backend selection.

use_cases.title: Protect Agent Endpoints
use_cases.description: Add rate limits and content safety controls for MCP tools and agent APIs.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Gateway Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose authentication, backend, cache, timeout, and content safety errors.

prompt_templates.title: Find Gateway Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find my APIM gateway URL, list AI backends, and identify the subscription key commands I need.

prompt_templates.title: Add an Azure OpenAI Backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding an Azure OpenAI backend to APIM using managed identity and least privilege RBAC.

prompt_templates.title: Apply AI Governance Policies
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an APIM policy plan for token limits, semantic caching, content safety, load balancing, and token metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Tenant Gateway
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a multi-tenant AI gateway with per-tenant limits, metrics, managed identity, and troubleshooting checks.

output_examples.input: I need to add Azure OpenAI behind APIM.
output_examples.output: The skill returns ordered setup steps, required Azure CLI checks, managed identity guidance, and policy placement notes.

output_examples.input: My gateway returns 401 from Azure OpenAI.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies likely RBAC, managed identity, endpoint, or propagation issues and suggests focused verification steps.

output_examples.input: I need cost controls for repeated AI prompts.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends token rate limits, semantic cache lookup and store policies, token metrics, and streaming compatibility checks.

best_practices: Use managed identity and Azure RBAC for production authentication.
Place authentication, cache lookup, token limits, content safety, backend selection, and metrics in the documented order.
Test gateway calls after each backend or policy change.
anti_patterns: Do not use DefaultAzureCredential as the production authentication default.
Do not expose AI backends without token limits, content safety, or access controls.
Do not enable semantic caching for streaming responses.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy Azure API Management?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on AI Gateway configuration after APIM and AI resources exist.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends managed identity and Azure RBAC for production workloads.

faq.question: Can it help with Azure OpenAI cost controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers token limits, semantic caching, backend balancing, and token metrics.

faq.question: Does it cover MCP tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes rate limiting and protection patterns for MCP tools and API endpoints.

faq.question: Can it diagnose failed gateway calls?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common 401, 429, cache, timeout, backend, and content safety issues.

faq.question: Is this skill tied to Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
